==Notes==
*Hopping Vampires that [[spawn]] at the beginning of the mission do not [[drop]] loot, but ones later on do.  Previously, players [[Farming|farmed]] Hopping Vampires by using decoys such as [[spirit]]s to sacrifice themselves upon, and their drops were removed in response.

==Trivia==
*The term [[W:hopping vampire|hopping vampire]] is likely a reference to the colloquial term for the Chinese mythological creature, commonly Romanised as ''jiangshi'', "stiff corpse."  Although they were quite similar before the evolution of the Western vampire myth during and after the mid 19th century, hopping vampires bear little resemblance (aesthetic or otherwise) to their western "cousins" today.  They were said to drain life force (rarely blood) from their victims, and were stiff with [[W:rigor mortis|rigor mortis]], hence their odd choice of locomotion.
